# Tasarım Standartları Kataloğu — Design Standards Catalog

> 85 design languages, each as a live HTML page plus a copy-paste AI generation prompt (English), palette, typography, layout, motion and an explicit avoid-list. Turkish/English UI. MIT licensed. Machine-readable data: https://design.asveas.com/ai/catalog.json — one Markdown file per style under https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/.

How to use with an AI coding tool: pick a style, read its `prompt_en` as the core prompt, use `palette`/`typography`/`layout` as concrete values and `avoid` as negative constraints, then compare the result with the live page. MCP server available in the repo (`mcp/`).

## Tools
- [Gallery — one to-do app in 85 styles](https://design.asveas.com/Galeri.dc.html)
- [Quiz — which design style are you?](https://design.asveas.com/Test.dc.html)
- [Mixer — blend two styles into one prompt](https://design.asveas.com/Mikser.dc.html)
- [Catalog JSON](https://design.asveas.com/ai/catalog.json)

## Curatorial schools (Küratörsel ve bireysel ekoller)

- [01 — Editorial Minimalism / Editoryal Minimalizm](https://design.asveas.com/01-editorial-minimalizm.dc.html): Editorial minimalism: magazine-like calm, oversized serif type, hairline rules and generous whitespace. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/01-editorial-minimalizm.md)
- [02 — Fluid & Immersive / Akışkan & Sürükleyici](https://design.asveas.com/02-akiskan-surukleyici.dc.html): Fluid immersive agency style: liquid transitions, cinematic depth and art-directed motion. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/02-akiskan-surukleyici.md)
- [03 — Futuristic Cyber / Gelecekçi Cyber](https://design.asveas.com/03-cyber-webgl.dc.html): Futuristic cyber immersion: dark stage, glowing particles and playful 3D atmosphere. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/03-cyber-webgl.md)
- [04 — Brutalist & Provocative / Brütalist & Provokatif](https://design.asveas.com/04-anti-design-provokatif.dc.html): Anti-design provocation: broken grids, layered chaos and rule-breaking typography. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/04-anti-design-provokatif.md)
- [05 — Functional Industrial / Fonksiyonel Endüstriyel](https://design.asveas.com/05-fonksiyonel-endustriyel.dc.html): Functional industrial rationalism: 'less but better', muted neutrals and precise grids. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/05-fonksiyonel-endustriyel.md)
- [06 — Grunge Typography / Grunge Tipografi](https://design.asveas.com/06-grunge-tipografi.dc.html): Grunge typography: distressed textures, overlapping type and deliberate visual noise. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/06-grunge-tipografi.md)

## Contemporary SaaS currents (Çağdaş dijital ürün ve SaaS akımları)

- [07 — Dark SaaS / Karanlık SaaS](https://design.asveas.com/07-karanlik-saas.dc.html): Dark SaaS elegance: crisp sans, 1px borders and subtle neon glows on near-black. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/07-karanlik-saas.md)
- [08 — Bento Grid / Bento Grid](https://design.asveas.com/08-bento-grid.dc.html): Bento grid: modular rounded cells of mixed sizes organizing content at a glance. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/08-bento-grid.md)
- [09 — Neo-Brutalism / Neo-Brütalizm](https://design.asveas.com/09-neo-brutalizm.dc.html): Neo-brutalism: loud pastels, thick black outlines and hard offset shadows. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/09-neo-brutalizm.md)
- [10 — B2B Skeletal / B2B İskeletizm](https://design.asveas.com/10-b2b-gradient-iskeletizm.dc.html): B2B skeletal minimalism: flawless gradients and trustworthy clean white layouts. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/10-b2b-gradient-iskeletizm.md)

## Historical art movements (Tarihsel ve sanatsal akımlar)

- [11 — Bauhaus / Bauhaus](https://design.asveas.com/11-bauhaus.dc.html): Bauhaus: primary colors, elemental geometry and form-follows-function order. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/11-bauhaus.md)
- [12 — Swiss Grid / İsviçre Izgarası](https://design.asveas.com/12-isvicre-izgara.dc.html): Swiss grid: objective typography, mathematical layout and disciplined hierarchy. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/12-isvicre-izgara.md)
- [13 — Y2K Psychedelic / Y2K Saykodelik](https://design.asveas.com/13-y2k-saykodelik.dc.html): Y2K psychedelia: chrome gradients, bubble shapes and glossy retro-future excess. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/13-y2k-saykodelik.md)
- [14 — Retro Terminal / Retro Terminal](https://design.asveas.com/14-retro-terminal.dc.html): Retro terminal: phosphor green on black, monospace everything and CRT flavor. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/14-retro-terminal.md)
## Micro-visual texture trends (Mikro-görsel ve dokusal trendler)

- [15 — Glassmorphism / Glassmorphism](https://design.asveas.com/15-glassmorphism.dc.html): Glassmorphism: frosted translucent panels floating over vivid blurred color. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/15-glassmorphism.md)
- [16 — Neumorphism / Neomorphism](https://design.asveas.com/16-neomorphism.dc.html): Neumorphism: soft extruded surfaces with delicate inner and outer shadows. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/16-neomorphism.md)
- [17 — Claymorphism / Claymorphism](https://design.asveas.com/17-claymorphism.dc.html): Claymorphism: chubby 3D clay shapes, cheerful colors and rounded softness. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/17-claymorphism.md)
## Art movements on the web (Sanat akımlarının web karşılıkları)

- [18 — Art Nouveau / Art Nouveau](https://design.asveas.com/18-art-nouveau.dc.html): Art Nouveau: organic whiplash curves, botanical ornament and elegant flow. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/18-art-nouveau.md)
- [19 — Art Deco / Art Deco](https://design.asveas.com/19-art-deco.dc.html): Art Deco: gilded geometry, fan motifs and glamorous vertical rhythm. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/19-art-deco.md)
- [20 — De Stijl / De Stijl](https://design.asveas.com/20-de-stijl.dc.html): De Stijl: primary color planes locked in an asymmetric black grid. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/20-de-stijl.md)
- [21 — Constructivism / Konstrüktivizm](https://design.asveas.com/21-konstruktivizm.dc.html): Constructivism: diagonal red-and-black agitation, bold propaganda energy. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/21-konstruktivizm.md)
- [22 — Memphis Postmodern / Memphis](https://design.asveas.com/22-memphis-postmodern.dc.html): Memphis postmodern: playful clashing patterns, squiggles and pastel confetti. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/22-memphis-postmodern.md)
- [23 — Mid-Century Modern / Mid-Century Modern](https://design.asveas.com/23-mid-century-modern.dc.html): Mid-century modern: warm optimism, organic shapes and tasteful restraint. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/23-mid-century-modern.md)
## Cultural & retro-futurist languages (Kültürel ve retro-fütürist diller)

- [24 — Vaporwave / Synthwave / Vaporwave / Synthwave](https://design.asveas.com/24-vaporwave-synthwave.dc.html): Vaporwave: neon sunset gradients, perspective grids and nostalgic haze. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/24-vaporwave-synthwave.md)
- [25 — Japanese Ma & Wabi-Sabi / Ma & Wabi-Sabi](https://design.asveas.com/25-japon-ma-wabi-sabi.dc.html): Japanese Ma & wabi-sabi: emptiness as material, imperfection as beauty. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/25-japon-ma-wabi-sabi.md)
- [26 — Iznik Geometric Motif / Geometrik Motif](https://design.asveas.com/26-cini-geometrik-motif.dc.html): Iznik tile geometry: cobalt and turquoise interlaced Ottoman patterns. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/26-cini-geometrik-motif.md)
- [27 — Solarpunk / Solarpunk](https://design.asveas.com/27-solarpunk-organik.dc.html): Solarpunk: hopeful green futures, organic curves and sunlit warmth. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/27-solarpunk-organik.md)
## Interface eras & surface languages (Arayüz dönemleri ve yüzey dilleri)

- [28 — Skeuomorphism / Skeuomorfizm](https://design.asveas.com/28-skeuomorfizm.dc.html): Skeuomorphism: tactile leather, stitches and real-world material metaphors. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/28-skeuomorfizm.md)
- [29 — Flat Design / Düz Tasarım](https://design.asveas.com/29-duz-tasarim-flat.dc.html): Flat design: pure color planes, zero depth and confident simplicity. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/29-duz-tasarim-flat.md)
- [30 — Maximalism / Maksimalizm](https://design.asveas.com/30-maksimalizm.dc.html): Maximalism: more is more — dense pattern, saturated color, joyful excess. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/30-maksimalizm.md)
## Principle-based standards (İlke temelli standartlar)

- [31 — Accessibility First / Erişilebilirlik Öncelikli](https://design.asveas.com/31-erisilebilirlik-oncelikli.dc.html): Accessibility-first: high contrast, big targets and clarity for everyone. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/31-erisilebilirlik-oncelikli.md)
- [32 — Public Service Plain Language / Kamu Hizmeti Tasarımı](https://design.asveas.com/32-kamu-hizmeti-sade-dil.dc.html): Plain-language public service: task-first single column, zero decoration. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/32-kamu-hizmeti-sade-dil.md)
- [33 — Raw HTML Brutalism / Ham HTML Brütalizmi](https://design.asveas.com/33-ham-html-brutalizmi.dc.html): Raw HTML brutalism: default styles, blue links and honest structure. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/33-ham-html-brutalizmi.md)

## Behavioral design & psychology (Davranış tasarımı ve psikoloji)

- [40 — Habit Loop & Streaks / Alışkanlık & Seri](https://design.asveas.com/40-aliskanlik-dongusu-seri.dc.html): Hook habit loop: trigger, action, variable reward, investment. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/40-aliskanlik-dongusu-seri.md)
- [41 — Gamified Progress / Oyunlaştırma](https://design.asveas.com/41-oyunlastirma-ilerleme.dc.html): Gamified progress: XP bars, streaks and badges without pressure. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/41-oyunlastirma-ilerleme.md)
- [42 — Social Proof & Scarcity / Sosyal Kanıt & Kıtlık](https://design.asveas.com/42-sosyal-kanit-kitlik.dc.html): Social proof & scarcity: verifiable signals versus fabricated urgency. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/42-sosyal-kanit-kitlik.md)
- [43 — Defaults & Anchoring / Varsayılan & Çapa](https://design.asveas.com/43-varsayilan-capa-fiyat.dc.html): Defaults & anchoring: price framing and pre-selected honest choices. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/43-varsayilan-capa-fiyat.md)
- [44 — Micro-interactions & Peak-End / Mikro Etkileşim](https://design.asveas.com/44-mikro-etkilesim-zirve-son.dc.html): Micro-interactions & peak-end: the two moments memory keeps. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/44-mikro-etkilesim-zirve-son.md)
- [45 — Dark Patterns (Warning) / Karanlık Desenler](https://design.asveas.com/45-karanlik-desenler-etik.dc.html): Dark patterns exposed: six manipulations and their honest counterparts. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/45-karanlik-desenler-etik.md)

## If painters designed interfaces (Ressamlar arayüz tasarlasaydı)

- [62 — Da Vinci · Codex / Da Vinci · Kodeks](https://design.asveas.com/62-da-vinci-kodeks.dc.html): Da Vinci's codex: parchment, sepia ink sketches, marginalia and mirror writing. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/62-da-vinci-kodeks.md)
- [63 — Monet · Light / Monet · Işık](https://design.asveas.com/63-monet-isik.dc.html): Monet's light: no outlines — the same screen painted at three times of day. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/63-monet-isik.md)
- [64 — Van Gogh · Starry Night / Van Gogh · Yıldızlı Gece](https://design.asveas.com/64-van-gogh-yildizli.dc.html): Van Gogh's starry night: swirling skies, impasto texture, brushstroke progress. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/64-van-gogh-yildizli.md)
- [65 — Picasso · Cubist / Picasso · Kübist](https://design.asveas.com/65-picasso-kubist.dc.html): Picasso's cubism: a portrait split into planes, seen from every angle at once. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/65-picasso-kubist.md)
- [66 — Dalí · Melting Clock / Dalí · Eriyen Saat](https://design.asveas.com/66-dali-eriyen-saat.dc.html): Dalí's melting clock: a surreal alarm app where time literally drips. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/66-dali-eriyen-saat.md)
- [67 — Hokusai · Great Wave / Hokusai · Büyük Dalga](https://design.asveas.com/67-hokusai-dalga.dc.html): Hokusai's great wave: ukiyo-e flat layers where the wave itself is the gauge. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/67-hokusai-dalga.md)
- [68 — Klimt · Gold / Klimt · Altın](https://design.asveas.com/68-klimt-altin.dc.html): Klimt's gold: mosaic-textured golden cards glowing on darkness. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/68-klimt-altin.md)
- [69 — Frida · Diary / Frida · Günlük](https://design.asveas.com/69-frida-gunluk.dc.html): Frida's diary: cobalt walls, botanical frames and ex-voto hearts for feelings. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/69-frida-gunluk.md)
- [70 — Kandinsky · Synesthesia / Kandinsky · Senestezi](https://design.asveas.com/70-kandinsky-senestezi.dc.html): Kandinsky's synesthesia: shapes as instruments, composition as score. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/70-kandinsky-senestezi.md)
- [71 — Rembrandt · Light Room / Rembrandt · Işık Odası](https://design.asveas.com/71-rembrandt-isik-odasi.dc.html): Rembrandt's chiaroscuro: one warm light, cards emerging from darkness. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/71-rembrandt-isik-odasi.md)
- [72 — Osman Hamdi · Patience / Osman Hamdi · Sabır](https://design.asveas.com/72-osman-hamdi-sabir.dc.html): Osman Hamdi's patience: a focus app born from The Tortoise Trainer — light through the arch, progress at turtle pace. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/72-osman-hamdi-sabir.md)

- [78 — Cyberpunk / Cyberpunk](https://design.asveas.com/78-cyberpunk.dc.html): Cyberpunk: dirty neon, glitch headlines, scanlines and hazard stripes — high tech, low life. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/78-cyberpunk.md)
- [79 — Pixel Art / Pixel Art](https://design.asveas.com/79-pixel-art.dc.html): Pixel art: 4px grid, limited palette, block shadows and CSS-drawn sprites — console nostalgia. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/79-pixel-art.md)

## Cultural & retro-futurist languages (Kültürel ve retro-fütürist diller)

## Historical art movements (Tarihsel ve sanatsal akımlar)

- [82 — Victorian Era / Viktorya Dönemi](https://design.asveas.com/82-viktorya.dc.html): Victorian: double-rule frames, fleurons, centered serifs and engraving textures — ornament as hierarchy. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/82-viktorya.md)

## Cultural & retro-futurist languages (Kültürel ve retro-fütürist diller)

- [83 — Graffiti / Graffiti](https://design.asveas.com/83-graffiti.dc.html): Graffiti: brick wall, multi-outline bubble letters, spray haze and drips — street energy. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/83-graffiti.md)

## Micro-visual texture trends (Mikro-görsel ve dokusal trendler)

- [84 — Aurora / Aurora](https://design.asveas.com/84-aurora.dc.html): Aurora: drifting green-violet-cyan light curtains on night, blurred depth and thin white type. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/84-aurora.md)
- [85 — Handwritten / El Yazısı](https://design.asveas.com/85-el-yazisi.dc.html): Handwritten: grid notebook, script fonts, highlighter marks, doodle arrows and sticky notes — human warmth. [md](https://design.asveas.com/ai/styles/85-el-yazisi.md)
